Veterans Benefits: Wyoming has no individual state income tax, so military retirement pay is not subject to state income tax. Qualifying veterans may also receive a $6,000 exemption from the assessed value of a primary residence, or apply it toward vehicle licensing, subject to residency and service eligibility requirements.
Description: Cody is a small regional center in northwestern Wyoming near the east entrance to Yellowstone National Park, with a dry high-plains climate, strong outdoor recreation and tourism economy, and unusually good local VA access for a city of its size (a VA clinic inside city limits). No confirmed physical defense-industry or major-employer presence was found; the economy leans on tourism, healthcare, retail and regional services.
